title: A Quasipolynomial Algorithm for $\ell_\infty$ Contractions
abstract: arXiv:2610.30122v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We give an algorithm for computing an $\eps$-approximate fixed point of any $d$-dimensional nonexpansion with respect to the $\ell_\infty$ norm in time $\log(1/\eps)^{O(\log^2 d)}$. At its core, our method uses a boosting argument to geometrically shrink a search region. Among other consequences, our algorithm implies that simple stochastic games can be solved in quasipolynomial time.

translated_title: 关于 $\ell_\infty$ 收缩映射的拟多项式算法
translated_abstract: 我们给出了一种算法，可以在 $\log(1/\eps)^{O(\log^2 d)}$ 的时间内计算任意关于 $\ell_\infty$ 范数的 $d$ 维非扩张映射的 $\eps$-近似不动点。我们的方法核心在于使用一种提升论证来几何级地缩小搜索区域。作为诸多推论之一，我们的算法意味着简单随机博弈可以在拟多项式时间内求解。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在拟多项式时间内计算 $\ell_\infty$ 范数下非扩张映射的近似不动点的算法，由此推出简单随机博弈可以在拟多项式时间内求解。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a quasipolynomial-time algorithm for computing approximate fixed points of nonexpansive mappings under the $\ell_\infty$ norm, implying that simple stochastic games can be solved in quasipolynomial time.
